Population of legislative districts by Region, Province, and selected Highly Urbanized/Component City : 2015 |publisher=[[Philippine Statistics Authority]] |accessdate=February 26, 2021 }} |electorate = 247,814 (2022){{cite web|url=https://comelec.gov.ph/?r=2022NLE/Statistics/2022RVVAVmcocfinal|title=Number and Turn-Out of Registered Voters and Voters Who Actually Voted by City/Municipality May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections|website=Commission on Elections|accessdate=June 30, 2023}} |area = {{convert|3297.07|sqkm|sqmi|abbr=on}} |towns = {{Collapsible list | titlestyle = font-weight:normal;text-align:left;background-color:WhiteSmoke; | title = 5 [[Local government in the Philippines|LGU]]s | '''Cities''' | [[Malaybalay]] | '''Municipalities''' | [[Cabanglasan]] | [[Impasugong]] | [[Lantapan]] | [[San Fernando, Bukidnon|San Fernando]] }} |year = 1987 |members_label = Representative |members = [[Jonathan Keith Flores]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Lakas–CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas–CMD]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Bukidnon's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the four [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Bukidnon]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 26, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district encompasses the provincial capital city of [[Malaybalay]] and the entire eastern frontier of Bukidnon bordering the [[Caraga]] and [[Davao Region|Davao]] regions. Its municipalities are [[Cabanglasan]], [[Impasugong]], [[Lantapan]] and [[San Fernando, Bukidnon|San Fernando]].{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2012/09/28/republic-act-no-10184/ |title=Republic Act No. 10184 |date=28 September 2012 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=February 26, 2021}} Prior to redistricting in 2012, the district also covered the city of [[Valencia, Bukidnon|Valencia]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 26, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Jonathan Keith Flores]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |website=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=June 30, 2023}}{{cite news|url=https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1201609|title=Lakas-CMD welcomes 71st House member|first=Zaldy|last=De Layola|work=Philippine News Agency|date=May 16, 2023|accessdate=June 30, 2023}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
